transport: Supabase REST /rest/v1/rpc with user Bearer JWT and public publishable apikey
authorization: Active user_roles.doctor plus own active staff.category=doctor; server derives doctor from auth.uid()

doctor_native_lab_orders.p_offset: integer >=0; own authorized orders, pages of 25, independent of appointment day

doctor_native_labs.p_key: stable uuid; identical selection retry returns same order_ids,count, atomically

doctor_native_admission_request.p_key: stable uuid; identical retry returns same admission

doctor_native_patients.p_query: name, DUI (with or without hyphen), linked account email, or record code; string <=120

doctor_native_start.p_key: stable uuid; retries return existing encounter

p_values.plan: string <=10000; no longer captured by the six-field form, resent unchanged
p_values.diagnosis_code: optional string <=50; no diagnosis catalog published

vitals.systolic: optional integer string; legacy, not captured, resent unchanged
vitals.diastolic: optional integer string; legacy, not captured, resent unchanged
vitals.heart_rate: optional integer string; legacy, not captured, resent unchanged

doctor_native_finish.p_version: last saved version; deployed server requires subjective, objective, assessment and plan. After supabase/doctor-consultation-six-fields.sql (prepared, not applied): subjective (symptoms), assessment (diagnosis) and objective (observations); plan optional and preserved

doctor_native_alerts.p_offset: integer 0..100000; page size 30; items,unread,has_more,upcoming; own identity from auth.uid; deduplicates due reminders

rules: Never submit doctor/user identity as authorization
Lab and prescription keys are stable across retries
Finishing closes encounter and completes appointment atomically
Patients and unrelated doctors are rejected
No lab-result write endpoint for doctors
iOS and local web-preview remain in parity; external administration panel is separate
Notes and diagnoses: active author doctor, or owning active patient after completion
Notifications are personal; 15-minute reminders; native local scheduling requires permission and prior sync

my_consultation_history.p_cursor: {value:started_at,id:uuid}|null; 26 rows for 25-row pagination; no patient identifier
